description: 경기도_버스 노선 인가횟수 및 배차 이력 정보 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도버스운송관리시스템(BMS)에서 수집된 노선별 차량 운영 및 배차 이력 정보로, 각 노선의 ‘노선ID’, 이를 운영하는 ‘업체ID’, 해당 배차의 고유 ‘이력ID’로. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 버스운송관리시스템, 버스ID, 버스변경이력, 버스노선이력, 차량운행정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
